scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @reviewly/web" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reviewly/shared && npm run build -w @reviewly/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @reviewly/web && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reviewly/shared && npm run typecheck -w @reviewly/web
scripts.test: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location services/gateway; if (-not (Test-Path .venv)) { python -m venv .venv }; .venv\Scripts\python -m pytest"
